preconditions.name: STATIC_H50::episode_outcome_spread_supra_floor
preconditions.description: MECH-323's evaluative gate is RELATIVE to a running baseline, so a flat outcome stream makes formation structurally impossible and every downstream ceiling reading meaningless. Asserts the SAME statistic the gate routes on (spread), never a mean or a magnitude proxy for it.
preconditions.control: worst cell in the arm; the task is a resource-and-hazard grid whose per-episode collection genuinely varies episode to episode

preconditions.name: STATIC_H50::symbol_buffer_per_episode
preconditions.description: record_step is reached only on the E3 deliberation path and E3 ticks every e3_steps_per_tick env steps, so the accumulator sees steps_per_episode/10 symbols per episode. note_outcome breaks out at len(actions) < size, so every ceiling at or above that count is STRUCTURALLY inert -- the exact defect that made V3-EXQ-810's 24-step episodes unable to reach sizes 4-5. Asserts the buffer clears the largest ceiling this ladder derives.
preconditions.control: worst cell in the arm; measured as chunk_acc_n_steps / n_episodes

preconditions.name: STATIC_H50::chunks_formed
preconditions.description: No chunk, no ceiling reading: the growth rules read the accumulator's live tally and the registered chunk set, so a silent accumulator makes every criterion here unmeasurable rather than false. This is the V3-EXQ-810 failure mode carried forward as a gate.

preconditions.control: worst cell in the arm; counted once per note_outcome by calling the same accessor the growth rule consumes
